#!/bin/sh
# gamedash-managed Voyagers of Nera server — generated by provision().
# This server's own files: <ROOT>/installs/nera/gamedash-servers/test
. <ROOT>/secrets.conf
python3 - "<ROOT>/installs/nera/gamedash-servers/test/Saved/PersistedData/nera_dedicatedserver/CustomConfig/CustomHostServerUserSettings.ini" "$GAME_SERVER_PASSWORD" "$GAME_ADMIN_PASSWORD" <<'SYNC'
import re, sys
p, join, admin = sys.argv[1:4]
t = open(p, encoding="utf-8", newline="").read()     # keep Windows line endings
for key, val in (
    ("HostServerPassword", join),
):
    t = re.sub(r'(?m)^%s=[^\r\n]*' % re.escape(key), lambda m: key + '=' + val, t)
open(p, "w", encoding="utf-8", newline="").write(t)
SYNC
rm -f "<ROOT>/installs/nera/gamedash-servers/test/Saved/DedicatedServerMagicJoinCode.txt"
export WINEPREFIX="<ROOT>/home/.wine-gd-nera-test"
export WINEDEBUG=-all
export WINEDLLOVERRIDES="mscoree,mshtml="   # no Mono/Gecko install prompts (headless)
# Run headless: Wine would otherwise open a console window on the desktop
# session (unsetting DISPLAY alone isn't enough — it falls back to Wayland).
unset DISPLAY
export WAYLAND_DISPLAY=wayland-none
cd "<ROOT>/installs/nera/BoatGame/Binaries/Win64" || exit 1
exec wine ./BoatGameServer-Win64-Shipping.exe -log -port=7777 -userdir="Z:<WINROOT>\\installs\\nera\\gamedash-servers\\test\\"
